definitions.short: Mechujael or Mechijael , an antediluvian patriarch
definitions.full: H4232. Mechuyael or Mechiyyayel מְחוּיָאֵל proper name, masculine great-grandson of Cain Gen 4:18 a = מְחִיָּיאֵ֯ל 4:18 b (J; A ᵐ5 L in both Μαιηλ , E Μαουιηλ ; compare further Lag Or. ii, 35 BN 96 ( Μαιουιαηλ ) Bu Urgesch.125 ). — (etymology dubious; Thes Add. 97 perhaps smitten of El √ מחה ; Bu Urgesch. 128 Kerber Eigennam, d. AT. 91 מְחַיִּיאֵל , or מַחְיִיאֵל El maketh alive ; DHM MV 10 thinks of proper name, of divinity יאל , — compare Phoenician proper name יאלפעל , and CIS i. 132, 4 ; especially p. 163 b, = god יאל giveth life (against this Gray Prop. N. 164 )). מַחֲוִים see below II. חוה . I. מָחוֺל see חול .
